eff_lead: The values the tool sees, each with its origin. JGates only shows what it can prove from the file.
eff_reason_EXTEND_NOT_RESOLVED: The file uses {key} (line {line} of {file}) to inherit another configuration. JGates does not resolve the inherited file: the values below are only those of this file, and the tool may see others.
eff_reason_NOT_EVALUATED: {file} is an executable file ({format}). JGates does not run it to read the values: only the tool itself knows the result.
eff_reason_NO_STRUCTURED_READER: There is no structured reader for {file} yet. See and edit the text in the Files tab.
eff_reason_STRUCTURED_UNAVAILABLE: Structured reading of {file} is not available on this machine. See the text in the Files tab.
eff_reason_DOCUMENT_MISSING: The file {file} does not exist yet: the tool uses its defaults.
eff_reason_NO_CONFIG_BINDING: This instance does not declare a main configuration file.
eff_prevailing: Flags and variables that prevail over the file
eff_prevailing_lead: The plan command passes these options to the tool; they weigh more than the same value in the file.
eff_prevailing_none: The command adds no flags or variables.
